title: Sparkly star
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Main star body -->
  <polygon points='50,12 60,38 88,38 65,55 73,82 50,66 27,82 35,55 12,38 40,38' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  
  <!-- Inner highlight on star -->
  <polygon points='50,22 56,40 76,40 60,51 66,70 50,58 34,70 40,51 24,40 44,40' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  
  <!-- Center glow -->
  <polygon points='50,32 53,44 65,44 55,51 59,63 50,56 41,63 45,51 35,44 47,44' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  
  <!-- Face on the star -->
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='46' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='46' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='44.5' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='44.5' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Happy smile -->
  <path d='M43,53 Q50,59 57,53' stroke='#2A2A4A' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle top-left -->
  <g transform='translate(18,18)'>
    <polygon points='0,-7 1.5,-1.5 7,0 1.5,1.5 0,7 -1.5,1.5 -7,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle top-right -->
  <g transform='translate(82,20)'>
    <polygon points='0,-9 2,-2 9,0 2,2 0,9 -2,2 -9,0 -2,-2' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle bottom-left -->
  <g transform='translate(15,75)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.3,-1.3 6,0 1.3,1.3 0,6 -1.3,1.3 -6,0 -1.3,-1.3' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle bottom-right -->
  <g transform='translate(85,72)'>
    <polygon points='0,-8 1.8,-1.8 8,0 1.8,1.8 0,8 -1.8,1.8 -8,0 -1.8,-1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='12' r='1.8' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='45' r='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='88' r='2' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='88' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  
  <!-- Tiny sparkle accents -->
  <g transform='translate(25,35)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(76,32)'>
    <polygon points='0,-2.5 0.7,-0.7 2.5,0 0.7,0.7 0,2.5 -0.7,0.7 -2.5,0 -0.7,-0.7' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
